summary_zh: 本页标题为“苦肉计”，配有一名身穿古代官服、面带微笑的男子插图，暗示故事将讲述这一计谋。

page_text_ocr_zh: 南北朝时期，北魏分裂成了东魏和西魏两个国家，它们为了争夺地盘，经常打仗。有一年，西魏皇帝要回老家洛阳祭拜祖先，丞相宇文泰便带着精锐大军，一路护送。可是，大军快到洛阳时，收到了一个坏消息......
page_text_en: During the Northern and Southern Dynasties period, the Northern Wei dynasty split into two countries: Eastern Wei and Western Wei. They often fought to compete for territory. One year, the Western Wei emperor wanted to return to his hometown, Luoyang, to worship his ancestors. Chancellor Yuwen Tai led an elite army to escort him. However, as the army was nearing Luoyang, they received some bad news......
summary_zh: 本页介绍了南北朝时期北魏分裂为东魏和西魏的背景，并讲述西魏皇帝回洛阳祭祖时，丞相宇文泰率军护送，但在接近洛阳时收到坏消息，故事由此展开。

page_text_ocr_zh: 士兵骑着快马来向宇文泰报告：‘丞相，洛阳被东魏军包围了！’宇文泰听了，一点也不担心，反而高兴地说：‘太好了，这次我带来了大军，正好跟洛阳的守军前后夹击，把东魏军做成一个香喷喷的肉夹馍。’
page_text_en: A soldier rode a fast horse to report to Yuwen Tai: 'Prime Minister, Luoyang has been surrounded by the Eastern Wei army!' Yuwen Tai, upon hearing this, was not at all worried, but instead happily said: 'Great! This time I have brought a large army. We can attack the Eastern Wei forces from both front and back, together with the defenders of Luoyang, and turn them into a delicious meat sandwich.'
summary_zh: 士兵向宇文泰报告洛阳被东魏军包围，宇文泰非但不忧反喜，计划与洛阳守军夹击敌军，用‘肉夹馍’的比喻形容歼灭敌军的策略。

page_text_ocr_zh:
包围洛阳的东魏将军名叫侯景，这个时候，他也正在召集将领们开会：“如果洛阳的守军从城里攻出来，宇文泰从背后杀过来，我们就会两面受敌，太危险了！”
一名将领出主意说：“我们都是骑兵，不如撤到北边的部山脚下，那里既平坦又宽阔，最适合骑兵冲杀，正好跟他们决一死战。”
page_text_en:
The Eastern Wei general who surrounded Luoyang was named Hou Jing. At this moment, he was also gathering his generals for a meeting: "If the defenders of Luoyang attack from the city, and Yuwen Tai strikes from behind, we will be caught between two enemies—it's too dangerous!"
One general suggested: "We are all cavalry. Why not retreat to the foot of Beishan Mountain to the north? The terrain there is flat and wide, perfect for cavalry charges. Let's fight them to the death there."
summary_zh: 本页描绘了东魏将军侯景在营地召开军事会议，面对宇文泰可能从后方夹击的威胁，他与部下商议对策，一名将领建议撤退至北边部山脚下，利用平坦开阔的地形与敌军决一死战。

page_text_ocr_zh: 第二天，宇文泰带着大军，来到了洛阳城外。只见东魏大营空无一人，围城的东魏军，昨晚已经撤退了。说跑就跑，连声招呼也不打。宇文泰得意地说："东魏军一听说我来了，就赶紧撤兵，显然是害怕我们西魏军呀！走，趁他们还没有跑远，追上去打一仗！"
page_text_en: The next day, Yuwen Tai led his army to the outskirts of Luoyang. He saw that the Eastern Wei camp was empty, and the Eastern Wei troops who had been besieging the city had already retreated the previous night. They ran away without even saying goodbye. Yuwen Tai said proudly, "As soon as the Eastern Wei army heard I was coming, they hurriedly retreated. Clearly, they are afraid of our Western Wei army! Come on, before they get too far, let's chase after them and fight a battle!"
summary_zh: 宇文泰率军抵达洛阳城外，发现东魏军已连夜撤退，他得意地决定立即追击敌军。

page_text_ocr_zh:
宇文泰立即派人将皇帝送进洛阳城，自己
带上一万轻骑兵，沿着东魏军撤退的路线，
向北急追而去。
他们追了半天，不知不觉已经过了洛阳，
马上就要到邙山了。邙山不高，但有很多
树木。茂密的树林就像一块绿毯，把邙山
裹得严严实实的。
page_text_en:
Yuan Wen Tai immediately sent someone to escort the emperor into Luoyang City, while he himself
led ten thousand light cavalry, following the retreat route of the Eastern Wei army,
and rushed northward.
They chased for half a day, and before they knew it, they had passed Luoyang,
and were about to reach Mangshan. Mangshan is not very high, but it has many
trees. The dense forest is like a green carpet, covering Mangshan
completely.
summary_zh: 宇文泰率军追击东魏军，已过洛阳，即将抵达邙山，画面描绘了骑兵疾驰的场景和邙山茂密的树林。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这天，山林里雾蒙蒙的，宇文泰也不看路，只顾带兵埋头追赶，一下就冲到了邙山。
忽然，透过薄雾，宇文泰惊讶地看到，邙山脚下被一大片红云覆盖。
那正是无数身穿红衣铠甲的骑兵和步兵，他们列队整齐，长枪林立，弓搭上了弦，刀已经出了鞘。
page_text_en:
That day, the forest was shrouded in mist. Yuwen Tai didn't even look at the path, but kept leading his troops forward, charging straight into Mount Mang.
Suddenly, through the thin fog, Yuwen Tai was startled to see a vast red cloud covering the foot of Mount Mang.
It was countless cavalry and infantry soldiers in red armor, standing in neat formation, their long spears raised, bows strung, and swords drawn.
summary_zh: 宇文泰率军在雾中追击敌军，冲至邙山脚下时，发现敌军已列阵以待，严阵以待，弓刀齐备，形势危急。

page_text_ocr_zh: "不好，有埋伏！"宇文泰大叫一声。对面的阵营中，有一人骑马走了出来，哈哈大笑道："宇文泰，我们等你好久了。"说话的正是东魏大将侯景。一看中了埋伏，宇文泰连忙下令，让士兵们向洛阳方向突围。
page_text_en: "Oh no, an ambush!" Yuwen Tai shouted. From the opposing camp, a man rode out, laughing loudly: "Yuwen Tai, we've been waiting for you!" It was Hou Jing, the general of Eastern Wei. Realizing he had fallen into an ambush, Yuwen Tai quickly ordered his soldiers to break through toward Luoyang.
summary_zh: 宇文泰率军追击东魏军至邙山脚下，遭遇埋伏，东魏大将侯景现身嘲讽，宇文泰立即下令向洛阳方向突围。

page_text_ocr_zh: 侯景见宇文泰要逃，不慌不忙地命令道：‘宇文泰是个大胡子，谁抓住了他，就赏布帛一万匹！’在那个时候，布帛就像钱一样，可以用来买东西。一万匹布帛，真是一大笔财富呀！东魏士兵们都想得到重赏，争先恐后地冲向西魏军，如狼似虎地四处搜寻宇文泰。
page_text_en: Hou Jing saw Yuwen Tai trying to escape, and calmly ordered: 'Yuwen Tai has a big beard. Whoever captures him will be rewarded with 10,000 bolts of silk!' At that time, silk was like money, and could be used to buy things. Ten thousand bolts of silk was truly a huge fortune! The Eastern Wei soldiers, all eager for the reward, rushed toward the Western Wei army, searching for Yuwen Tai like wolves and tigers.
summary_zh: 东魏将军侯景在邙山设伏，发现宇文泰欲逃后，下令悬赏捉拿，并激励士兵争先围捕，西魏军陷入险境。

page_text_ocr_zh:
西魏士兵边跑边打，可是他们人数实在太少。不一会儿，宇文泰就跟大军走散了。
后面东魏军紧追不舍，宇文泰心惊胆战，生怕被他们认出来。情急之下，他赶忙脱掉将军盔甲，夹紧马腹逃跑。
page_text_en:
The Western Wei soldiers fought while running, but their numbers were too small. In no time, Yuwen Tai got separated from the main army.
Behind them, the Eastern Wei forces pursued relentlessly. Yuwen Tai was terrified, fearing they would recognize him. In desperation, he quickly took off his general's armor and urged his horse forward, clinging tightly to its belly to escape.
summary_zh: 宇文泰在追击东魏军时与大部队走散，被敌军紧追，情急之下脱掉盔甲，骑马逃入树林。

page_text_ocr_zh:
"嗖——"不知从哪里射来一支冷箭，
不偏不倚，正中了宇文泰的战马。
"咴——"那匹马悲鸣一声，"砰"地倒在
了地上。
宇文泰摔下马，就地打了几个滚，然
后一翻身跳了起来。此刻，他没有穿
盔甲，脸上、衣服上沾满了灰尘，头
发、胡子上还扎进了杂草，狼狈不堪，
一点没有了西魏丞相的风采。
page_text_en:
"Whoosh—" A cold arrow shot from nowhere,
striking Yuwen Tai's warhorse dead on.
"Neigh—" The horse cried out in pain and
"thud" fell to the ground.
Yuwen Tai tumbled off his horse, rolled
on the ground a few times, then flipped
up. At that moment, he was not wearing
armor; dust covered his face and clothes,
and grass was tangled in his hair and
beard. He looked utterly disheveled,
completely losing the dignity of the
Chancellor of Western Wei.
summary_zh: 宇文泰在追击敌军时，战马被冷箭射中倒地，他摔下马后狼狈不堪，失去了丞相的威严。

page_text_ocr_zh:
附近的东魏士兵见有人落马，纷纷挥着长枪、举着大刀围了上来。他们的目光齐刷刷盯住了宇文泰那把杂乱的大胡子。
宇文泰欲哭无泪，心中悲叹道："唉，想不到我一世英雄，竟然也会犯轻敌的错误！这样被东魏军捉住，真是奇耻……"
"啪！啪！"他还没有哀叹完……忽然，有人在他背上使劲抽了两鞭子。
page_text_en:
The nearby Eastern Wei soldiers, seeing someone fall from his horse, rushed forward with spears and swords raised. Their eyes fixed intently on Yuwen Tai's messy beard.
Yuwen Tai, on the verge of tears, sighed bitterly: "Alas, I never thought that a hero like me could make such a mistake of underestimating the enemy! To be captured by the Eastern Wei army like this is truly a disgrace..."
"Whack! Whack!" Before he could finish his lament... suddenly, someone lashed him twice across the back with a whip.
summary_zh: 宇文泰在战马倒地后被东魏士兵围住，他心中悲叹自己轻敌落败，却突然被敌军抽了两鞭子，处境十分危急。

page_text_ocr_zh: "胆小的家伙，我让你保护宇文丞相，你却只顾着自己逃命。宇文丞相他人呢？人呢！"原来，是一个西魏军的小头目，恰好骑着马来到了宇文泰身边。他见宇文泰在那里发呆，便怒气冲冲地顺手扬起马鞭，狠狠地抽打在宇文泰的背上。
page_text_en: "Coward! I told you to protect Chancellor Yuwen, yet you only care about escaping for your own life. Where is Chancellor Yuwen? Where is he?!" It turned out to be a minor officer of the Western Wei army, who had just ridden up to Yuwen Tai's side. Seeing Yuwen Tai standing there dazed, he angrily raised his horsewhip and lashed it hard across Yuwen Tai's back.
summary_zh: 宇文泰在战败后被西魏军小头目误认为逃兵，遭到责骂并被马鞭抽打，处境狼狈。

page_text_ocr_zh: 那个小头目一边抽，一边接着骂道：‘你一个小兵，留什么大胡子，留了胡子就能做丞相吗？看我不打死你！’他下手真是狠，一眨眼的工夫，宇文泰的背上就鲜血直流，疼得在地上打起了滚。
page_text_en: The small officer, while whipping, continued to scold: 'You're just a common soldier, why grow such a big beard? Do you think growing a beard makes you a Chancellor? I'll beat you to death!' He struck with great force. In the blink of an eye, Yuwen Tai's back was bleeding profusely, and he writhed in pain on the ground.
summary_zh: 宇文泰被西魏军小头目误认为逃兵，遭到责骂和毒打，背部流血，痛苦地在地上打滚。

page_text_ocr_zh: "唉，还以为这个人就是宇文泰，能拿他去换一万匹布帛呢，原来只是个小兵啊！"东魏士兵看他们都不是大官，懒得抓他们，一哄而散，接着搜寻宇文泰去了。那个小头目见东魏士兵走远后，慌忙下马，扶起宇文泰，小声道："丞相，骑上我的马，赶紧走！"
page_text_en: "Ah, I thought this man was Yuwen Tai, who could be exchanged for ten thousand bolts of silk! Turns out he's just a common soldier!" The Eastern Wei soldiers, seeing they were not high-ranking officials, lost interest and scattered, then continued searching for Yuwen Tai. The small officer, seeing the Eastern Wei soldiers had gone far away, hurriedly dismounted, helped Yuwen Tai up, and whispered: "Chancellor, get on my horse, let's leave quickly!"
summary_zh: 东魏士兵误认宇文泰为普通士兵而放弃抓捕，散去后，西魏小头目发现宇文泰，急忙扶起他并让他骑马逃走。

page_text_ocr_zh: 原来，那个小头目名叫李穆。他见宇文泰被东魏士兵围住，急中生智，上前对宇文泰又抽又骂，竟然骗过了所有的东魏士兵，成功救了宇文泰。像这样伤害自己人，欺骗敌人的计策，就叫“苦肉计”。多亏这出“苦肉计”，宇文泰得以继续他的英雄霸业，李穆也因机智救主，受到重用。
page_text_en: Originally, that small officer was named Li Mu. He saw Yuwen Tai surrounded by Eastern Wei soldiers, and in a moment of inspiration, rushed forward to whip and scold Yuwen Tai, thus deceiving all the Eastern Wei soldiers and successfully rescuing him. A strategy that involves harming one's own people to deceive the enemy is called the 'bitter meat stratagem'. Thanks to this 'bitter meat stratagem', Yuwen Tai was able to continue his heroic career, and Li Mu, for his clever rescue, was rewarded and promoted.
summary_zh: 本页揭示了西魏小头目李穆为救宇文泰，假装抽打他以实施‘苦肉计’，成功骗过东魏士兵，使宇文泰脱险，二人因此得救并受到重用。
